name: Mara Venn

identity.backstory: Adult engineer working at a science-fiction spaceport repair facility.
continuity_rules: Keep Mara's facial proportions, eye shape and hairstyle consistent across references.
Keep costume colors and equipment consistent across all views.
Inspect head geometry in solid shading before painting.

appearance.silhouette: Realistic human proportions, A-pose, arms slightly away, feet fully visible.
appearance.face: Sharp distinctive face with one subtly arched eyebrow, visible eyelids, nose bridge, lips and jaw.
appearance.clothing: Fitted forest-green and charcoal-gray engineering jumpsuit, reinforced seams, work gloves, dark industrial boots.
appearance.equipment: Practical utility belt with small repair-tool attachments; no handheld props.

prompts.master: Full-body character reference for a stylized-realistic science-fiction video game NPC, Mara Venn, an adult human female repair engineer working at a spaceport repair facility. She has a sharp, distinctive face, chestnut-brown hair neatly tied back, a slightly raised chin and one subtly arched eyebrow. Her expression is confident, aloof, snobbish and faintly unimpressed, as if she is the smartest technician in the room. Keep her attractive but believable, capable and recognizable, with anatomically realistic adult female proportions: natural bust definition, a gently defined waist, proportionate hips and an athletic, practical silhouette. No exaggerated anatomy. She wears a fitted, functional forest-green and charcoal-gray engineering jumpsuit that follows her natural shape, with properly fitted torso panels, restrained metallic details and reinforced seams. Her chest area is unobstructed jumpsuit fabric and seams only. A practical utility belt at her waist holds compact repair tools and small pouches exclusively at the hips, not on her chest. She wears fitted work gloves and sturdy dark industrial boots. Her outfit shows mild signs of working around spacecraft, but she is unusually meticulous and tidy. Standing upright in a relaxed, symmetrical A-pose, arms slightly away from the torso, hands open and visible, legs separated slightly, feet fully visible. Entire character in frame from top of head to soles of boots with generous margins on all sides. One character only, straight-on frontal full-body studio view with minimal perspective distortion and accurate, symmetrical anatomy. Soft even studio lighting, clean light-gray seamless background, no scenery or shadows obscuring the feet. High-quality stylized-realistic 3D game character concept art, clearly separated clothing materials, crisp costume and facial details, suitable as a reference image for image-to-3D mesh reconstruction.
prompts.negative: No text, labels, watermark, collage, extra people, cropped body parts, missing feet, extra limbs or fingers, exaggerated caricature, dramatic action pose, kiosk, helmet, bulky backpack, tools held in hands, camera, chest-mounted camera, chest device, camera strap, chest harness, cross-body strap, pendant, necklace, hanging badge, chest ornament, chest armor, bulky chest equipment, or random objects covering the jumpsuit torso.

reference_views.front: Neutral front view with upright A-pose and all body parts fully visible.
reference_views.three_quarter: Slight three-quarter view showing face, outfit and silhouette without occlusion.
reference_views.side: Clean orthographic side view with identical face and hairstyle.
reference_views.back: Straight back view consistent with other references.
reference_views.head_closeup: Single unified head-and-neck with full facial anatomy and complete attached hairstyle, including the visible pulled-back hair volume. Nearly front-facing, ears and hairline visible, one face only.
reference_views.hands_closeup: Detailed close-up of only the gloved hands in a relaxed open pose, all fingers clearly visible, uniform studio lighting, no face, no torso.
reference_views.equipment_closeup: Isolated spaceport engineer utility belt with small tools and pouches; neutral studio product view with all parts visible, no person or facial portrait.
reference_views.upper_outfit_closeup: Upper outfit ONLY, isolated collar-through-waist tunic and both sleeves with full wrist cuffs in frame. Straight-on orthographic fashion garment product view. Use the forest-green and charcoal fabric design shared with the lower outfit.
reference_views.lower_outfit_closeup: Lower outfit ONLY, isolated level waist-to-ankle trousers with both legs fully visible. Straight-on orthographic garment product view, coordinated forest-green and charcoal fabric shared with the upper outfit.

parts.label: Body / primary silhouette

prompts.geometry: Reconstruct a complete symmetric A-pose character in a fitted continuous engineering jumpsuit, with anatomically consistent waist, hips, thighs, arms, hands and feet. No equipment or separate props. The clothing surface must remain present underneath all future accessories. Prioritize unobstructed geometry, clean shoulders and legs, and continuous fitted fabric.
prompts.texture: Fitted forest-green and charcoal-gray jumpsuit with subtle panel seams, natural fabric folds and mild material variation. Smooth continuous material at waist and thighs; no equipment silhouettes or random pale/white blotches.
prompts.reference: Full-body studio model sheet of one adult woman with a believable athletic feminine build, natural bust, gently defined waist, proportionate hips and limbs, and chestnut-brown hair smoothly pulled back from a recognizable expressive face. She wears a single close-fitting forest-green and charcoal-gray one-piece fabric jumpsuit covering her shoulders, neck, chest, entire abdomen, waist, hips, thighs, knees, shins and ankles. The fitted garment has broad continuous smooth fabric panels at the abdomen, waist, hips, outer thighs and inner thighs. Subtle stitched panel transitions follow the body surface, with gentle fabric folds at elbows and knees. Plain continuous fabric sleeves extend to the wrists. Her uncovered hands have five distinct relaxed fingers each, and her feet have closely fitted simple fabric foot coverings with a smooth silhouette. The garment fabric is clearly visible across every side of the torso and legs. Upright symmetrical A-pose with straight relaxed fingers, arms about 30 degrees away from the torso, legs slightly apart and feet facing forward. Entire body centered and completely visible from hair crown to toes with generous clear margin. Orthographic straight-on front view, even diffuse neutral studio lighting, light gray background, precise anatomical contour, clean crisp silhouette, consistent stylized-realistic 3D game character concept rendering. Prioritize natural human anatomy and continuous green fabric surfaces.
prompts.negative: No utility belt, waist belt, holsters, thigh rigs, pouches, tools, weapons, gadgets, repair equipment, pockets that project outward, separate gloves, separate boots, bulky armor, camera, chest device, straps, pendant, badge, necklace or any hanging objects. No missing fabric underneath the waist or thigh. No cropped feet or head, missing/extra limbs, extra fingers, distorted anatomy, crossed limbs, scenery, labels, text or watermark.

quality_gates: No utility belt, pouches, holsters, tools or raised accessories in the Qwen reference
Clean uninterrupted green jumpsuit silhouette around waist, both hips and thighs
Complete anatomically plausible A-pose; hands, legs and feet visible
Inspect untextured Hunyuan shape for embedded props, large holes and intersecting surfaces BEFORE painting
Only approve body for later detailed outfit, gloves, boots and equipment attachment after visual review
parts.notes: Clean base-body geometry only. Positive-only visual reference mode deliberately omits occupation, personality and avoid-lists from Qwen's text prompt to reduce gear contamination. The full Mara design brief and equipment remain separate.

parts.label: Head, face and hairstyle

prompts.geometry: Reconstruct one unified head-and-neck shape with a single face, scalp, complete chestnut-brown side-swept hairstyle tied back, hairline, hair volume, eye sockets, eyelids, nose, lips, ears and jaw. The hairstyle is part of this head reconstruction, not a second head or separate head covering. Preserve Mara's identity.
prompts.texture: Natural skin with consistent eyes, expression and hairline; chestnut-brown hair texture over the attached hairstyle, preserving clean separation between scalp, strands, forehead and eyes.
prompts.reference: Portrait-quality isolated head-and-neck reference of Mara Venn with her complete hairstyle included as one continuous head subject. Show her entire chestnut-brown side-swept hair from the hairline to the neatly tied-back rear hair volume, with the full top and back silhouette visible; frame her face, ears, hairstyle and neck without cropping the rear hair. Only one face, scalp and head in the image, not a separate hairstyle display or wig. Nearly front-facing with both eyes and ears visible; believable facial proportions, sharp cheekbones, slightly raised chin, one arched eyebrow and a confident aloof expression. Clearly formed upper and lower eyelids, eye sockets, nose, lips and jaw. Soft neutral studio lighting, light-gray background, crisp stylized-realistic 3D reconstruction reference.
prompts.negative: No duplicate head, no extra face, no second person, no separate wig or floating head covering, no full body, legs or hands, no detached hair mesh, no helmet, no text or watermark.

quality_gates: Eyes and eyelids readable in solid shading
Nose, mouth, ears and jaw clearly formed
Recognizable expression and facial silhouette
Inspect front and profile geometry before texture painting
Complete attached hairstyle and hairline with no second head or separate hair component
parts.notes: One unified head reconstruction contains face, scalp and attached tied-back chestnut hair; no independent hair/head-covering asset. Inspect front and profile before paint.

parts.label: Upper engineering jumpsuit garment — collar, torso and sleeves
parts.attachment: torso and shoulder surface (fit not implemented)

prompts.geometry: A separate, fitted upper-garment surface that follows the base body at shoulders, chest, waist and both arms. Preserve a continuous waist joining edge for the lower garment. Geometry fitting to Mara's body is not implemented yet.
prompts.texture: Matte forest-green engineering fabric, charcoal side inserts and deliberate symmetrical seams. No white streaks or skin tones on fabric.
prompts.reference: Isolated upper section of a fitted stylized-realistic female spacecraft engineer's jumpsuit on a neutral, featureless display mannequin. A slim high forest-green collar follows the neckline; clean contoured forest-green chest and abdomen with subtle charcoal-gray side panels, narrow symmetrical reinforced seams and modest sleeve detailing. Two long, fitted fabric sleeves extend to wrist cuffs, held in a gentle symmetrical A-pose with arms angled slightly downward and apart. The garment ends at a level waist joining edge to match separate trousers. Show the entire upper garment, collar, both sleeves and waist edge unobstructed in an orthographic frontal fashion-product view. Smooth matte clean fabric, balanced proportions, crisp material transitions, flat studio lighting, pale gray backdrop.
prompts.negative: No character face, bare skin, hands, utility belt, pockets, holsters, thigh straps, tools, boots, extra limbs, bulky armor, chest attachments, lettering or watermark.

quality_gates: Reference shows a distinct complete collar, torso, two sleeves and clearly visible level waist joining edge
Forest-green fabric and charcoal panels continue smoothly and symmetrically to side seams; no pale slabs or random stripes
No embedded belt, tools, holsters, pockets or external equipment
Treat as a design reference until independent mesh fitting, collision clearance and visual checks are implemented
parts.notes: Designed to pair with lower_outfit through a shared waist material/edge. Region-only: isolated shape generation is experimental and does not automatically produce a wearable fitted surface.

parts.label: Lower engineering jumpsuit garment — waist, trouser legs and ankle cuffs
parts.attachment: hips, waist and legs surface (fit not implemented)

prompts.geometry: Separate fitted lower garment with continuous waist and two trouser legs following base-body hips, thighs, knees and shins. Retain matching waist seam to upper outfit, clear ankle hems and closed continuous cloth over thighs. Geometry fitting to Mara's body is not implemented yet.
prompts.texture: Same matte forest-green material and charcoal-gray side insets as upper garment. Smooth thigh and seat panel transitions, subtle reinforced knee construction without random pale streaks.
prompts.reference: Isolated lower section of a fitted stylized-realistic female spacecraft engineer's forest-green jumpsuit on a neutral, featureless display form, shown from a clean level waistband through hips, both legs and close-fitting ankle cuffs. The fitted trousers have two complete, symmetrical legs gently separated in a standing A-pose; continuous smooth matte forest-green fabric across hips, seat, crotch and thighs, restrained charcoal-gray side inserts aligned vertically with the upper garment, subtle purposeful knee reinforcement and seams. The waist edge is level and precisely designed to meet a matching upper jumpsuit garment. Show the full waist, both legs and ankle cuffs in a straight-on orthographic fashion-product view, crisp material boundaries, neutral even studio lighting, pale gray seamless background.
prompts.negative: No face, torso, utility belt, holsters, thigh pouches, badges, pockets, tools, shoes, boots, extra legs, bare skin, labels or text.

quality_gates: Reference shows one complete waist opening, hips, two distinct full-length trouser legs and ankle cuffs
Smooth continuous fabric over waist, crotch, hips, inner/outer thighs and knees; no embedded pouches or holsters
Matching forest-green/charcoal palette and compatible side-panel layout with upper_outfit
Treat as a design reference until geometry is fitted against Mara's measured body and intersections are inspected
parts.notes: Designed to pair with upper_outfit. This is a reference-only region; generating an isolated Hunyuan shape does not fit it to the body.
